title: The scaled restriction is integer multiplicity when the multiplicity is constant
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and V ⊆ U ⊆ ℝ^P with V open. Let T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) be represented by an IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in U, let N₀ ≥ 1 be an integer such that θ(x) = N₀ for μ_T-a.e. x ∈ V, where μ_T = R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M, and let T₀ ∈ 𝒟_n(V) satisfy T(ι ω) = N₀·T₀(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(V) (ι = testFormOnInclusion). Then T₀ is integer multiplicity in V (IsIntegerMultiplicity T₀); in fact (M ∩ V, 1, ξ) represents T₀.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U V : Set (Euclid P)) (hVU : V ⊆ U) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n) (T₀ : GeometricCurrentOn V n) (N₀ : ℕ), IsOpen V → 0 < N₀ → R.Represents T → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ V → R.mult x = N₀) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, T (testFormOnInclusion hVU n ω) = (N₀ : ℝ) * T₀ ω) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T₀
